title: An AI roadmap is a sequence of decisions.
seo_title: AI Roadmap Prioritisation: Five Decisions Before You Scale
description: A practical five-decision framework for prioritising AI use cases, clarifying ownership and choosing what evidence to gather before scaling.
excerpt: Five decisions that connect business priorities, delivery readiness and the people who will own the result.
takeaway: Leave with a five-decision frame you can use in your next roadmap meeting.
cta_title: Bring your roadmap into the conversation.
cta_text: If the priorities are hard to sequence or the ownership is unclear, let’s explore the next decision your team needs to make.

title: The pilot works. Does the work change?
seo_title: AI Adoption Beyond the Pilot: A Practical Leadership Review
description: How to assess AI adoption through real workflows, clear expectations, user feedback and operating ownership, with questions for your next rollout review.
excerpt: A practical look at the distance between a successful demonstration and a tool people can use in an ordinary working day.
takeaway: Use five questions to turn a vague adoption problem into a practical next step.
cta_title: Make the next rollout easier to carry.
cta_text: Let’s discuss where your team’s workflow, product and change approach need to come together.
cta_subject: Discuss AI adoption with our team

title: From AI experiments to everyday value.
seo_title: From GenAI Pilots to an Operating Model
description: A practical discussion guide for connecting GenAI priorities, workflow choices, ownership and adoption into an operating model.

takeaway: Take a five-point leadership agenda into the discussion about what should scale.
cta_title: Give your AI agenda a clearer operating shape.
